ERS-1234 — SPC updates the shortlist for a triaged referral

Test objective

Verify that an SPC can add Cardiology to the referral shortlist when the referral is in the 'Triaged - Provider to action' state and owned by the Triage service.

Test data

Referral

Id:REF-1234
State:Triaged - Provider to action
Owning service:Triage service
Initial shortlist:Respiratory

Patient

Id:PAT-1234
Name:Alex Morgan
Role:Patient associated with the referral
Organisation:R68

SPC

Id:SPC-321564
Name:Casey Morgan
Role:SPC performing the shortlist update
Organisation:R69

Triage service

Name:Service A - Triage
Provider:Hell's Pass Hospital
Organisation:R68

Referral notes

Triage recorded the referral from the ED discharge letter. The shortlist was agreed at the 14 Mar MDT; Respiratory was added by the triage nurse before SPC review.
Note type:Triage annotation
Recorded by:N. Okafor (triage nurse)
Recorded at:14 Mar, 09:41
Review status:Unreviewed
Casey flagged the annotation during review because it references a cardiology finding. The annotation stays attached to the referral after the shortlist update.

Update request

The shortlist update goes out as a single JSON payload against the referral API. The SPC never edits the payload by hand; the form builds it from the shortlist editor state.
{ "referralId": "REF-1234", "shortlist": ["Respiratory", "Cardiology"], "submittedBy": "SPC-321564", "idempotencyKey": "upd-9f2c" }
Content type:application/json
Endpoint:/api/referrals/REF-1234/shortlist
Method:PUT

Linked references

Response file:example-ers1234-shortlist-response.json
Record system:Referral manager (example.org)
example-ers1234-shortlist-response.json
Audit trail for REF-1234

Preconditions

The SPC is signed in with permission to edit referral shortlists. The referral is visible to the Triage service and currently has Respiratory on its shortlist.

Test steps

Open referral

Open referral REF-1234 from the Triage service work queue.

Update shortlist

Add Cardiology to the shortlist and leave Respiratory unchanged.

Save update

Save the referral and wait for the update confirmation.

Expected result

The shortlist contains Respiratory and Cardiology, the referral remains in 'Triaged - Provider to action', and the update is recorded against the SPC.
{ "referralId": "REF-1234", "action": "update-shortlist", "added": ["Cardiology"], "outcome": "passed" }
